questDescription(asker_factionLeader==True)->[asker_nameDef], [asker_faction_leaderTitle] of [asker_faction_name], has intercepted a mysterious broadcast. The signal carries encryption markers associated with a Forsaken military supersoldier program, and appears to have been transmitted from a site not far from our colony. 

[asker_nameDef] believes that tracking this signal will reveal the location of a hidden installation. On arrival, scouts reported finding a small, abandoned surface outpost with an open vault entrance leading deep underground.

Beneath lies a sealed laboratory complex. Inside must be some kind of Forsaken broadcasting station - intercepting the signal from it will allow us to trace its destination. 

The underground vault also contains something invaluable: an intact Archogen Injector. This rare device can be used to begin creating supersoldiers by injecting archites directly into human subjects. The injector, along with any other surviving lab equipment, should be claimed and brought back to the colony. 

The lab itself shows no active defenders, but Forsaken traps may still be functional and must be navigated with care.

questDescription(askerIsNull==True)->We've intercepted an unstable remote broadcast, requesting reinforcements for some unknown event. While seemingly not intended for us, the signal appears to originate from a laboratory responsible for producing Forsaken supersoldiers. 

The site must contain the broadcasting station responsible for the message. It is imperative that we intercept the broadcast on-site, to track where it is broadcasting to. 

This trek might be dangerous, as we have no way of knowing what lies at the site. Remaining technology at the site could prove useful, we should look at each piece of equipment carefully to take back with us if we dream of creating supersoldiers of our own.

questDescription->Your radio lights up with another request for E352. The automated satellite tells you of another vault, lurking somewhere in the distance. This vault is marked one of many in a series of "seized vaults", where supersoldier patients sealed off the genetic monstrosities underground. 

The site briefing attatched reads as follows:
[story]

 The satellite wants you to take care of the supersoldiers, then reopen the vault door. It refuses to elaborate on what the purpose of the mission is. Your only directive is to re-open the underground section of the vault. Once it has been unsealed, you may leave or loot the site for Forsaken technology.

questDescription(askerIsNull==True)->After intercepting the broadcasting station, we have identified an additional Forsaken laboratory site communicating with the previous. The lab is transmitting a code red signal, likely signifying an even stronger threat presence. It appears some of the monstrosities might have even escaped underground containment and broken onto the surface.\n\nThe site must contain an additional broadcasting station responsible for the message. It is imperative that we also intercept this broadcast on-site, to track where it is broadcasting to. Functioning technology at the site may prove useful in the improvement of supersoldier production. We should look at each piece of equipment carefully to take back with us if we intend to reliably produce supersoldiers of our own.

questDescription(askerIsNull==True)->Garbled through the static, it seems some Forsaken network has mistaken your radio for that of a Forsaken reconnaissance worker after detecting your travels through an automated satellite.

The message harshly refers to you as E352, and tasks you with scouting another supersoldier laboratory. Though this broadcast seems to have been running from some time now, it warns of a major uprising event within the lab. Supersoldiers had risen out of containment, and now roam the facility locked inside. The reconnaissance task states that the site was evacuated, yet the uprising was never contained and it is likely some may have escaped.

The broadcast also contains schematics of the location including your real objective. A device called the mutagen inhibitor core. Though just a prototype prior to its sudden abandonment, it is built to suppress unstable genetic mutations. It is likely that other valuable equipment remains here as well. offering transparent probabilities on genetic experiments. Our objective will be to locate the uplink and uninstall it for use in our own laboratory.

value.description: This quest chain will have you explore several underground lab complexes created by the Forsaken military to try and create supersoldiers through something called archite injection. You may be able to retrieve valuable lab equipment for yourself, to eventually create your own super soldiers, horrible abominations, or both.
